answer_2.quote: We conduct various analyses of the labels generated by the LLMs, utilizing the different prompt setups described in Section 3.2. First, we examine the extent to which LLM predictions align with the judgments of different human annotators by comparing the outputs generated from non-demographic (N) prompts to the human annotations available for each instance.

answer_4.quote: The POPQUORN data set consists of 45,000 annotations from 1,484 annotators with information on their gender, race, age, occupation and education.
